items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: And I haven't seen Jell-E Roll since then. I'd always kind of keep up with him wherever he would be and what he was doing.

ctx.x: No, it's good to have a change in the case of that. That was in 31. Then you moved out here.
And I haven't seen Jell-E Roll since then. I'd always kind of keep up with him wherever he would be and what he was doing.

And he went on to New York. Yes, I did. And then during the Depression he didn't have very good luck. He was in Washington when I met him and playing in a little night club there and helping run the club, but he didn't like it. And he stayed there until 1938. Then he went away back to New York in 39. And I only saw him once in New York up at the rhythm club where the musicians would all hang out. Yes. He played pool there a lot.
